label: Google Sheets
description: Official Google Sheets MCP server (hosted, Workspace Developer Preview). Lets the agent read spreadsheet metadata and values and apply atomic batch updates. Requires your own Google OAuth client.

setup.reason: bring your own Google OAuth client: add google-sheets to mcpServers with clientId, clientSecret, callbackPort and scopes, then run /mcp login google-sheets (guide: https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent/blob/main/docs/google-workspace-mcp.md)
